watchlist.name: AppLovin
watchlist.news_note: Soft Q2 (revenue miss, light Q3 guide) blamed on slower AI model improvements; faces securities class action (unproven allegations).

watchlist.name: Reddit
watchlist.news_note: Q2 2026 was a strong beat (revenue +61% YoY to $805M, above-consensus Q3 guide) but shares sold off ~21% on flagged weakness in U.S. search-referral traffic, raising a real question about traffic durability in the AI era; fundamentals still growing strongly but the moat concern warrants CAUTION.

watchlist.name: Insulet Corporation
watchlist.news_note: Two voluntary Omnipod 5 device corrections (Mar & May 2026, tubing tears affecting ~8.5% of 2025 pod output) triggered a pending securities-fraud class action (unproven allegations) and a Q2 revenue-guidance trim on weak Type 2 customer retention, though revenue still grew 23.5% with a Q2 beat.

watchlist.name: Rollins, Inc.
watchlist.news_note: Q2 EPS miss, margin -110 bps, soft residential demand; CFO stepped down June 15; routine plaintiffs'-firm probe announced.

watchlist.name: Ciena
watchlist.news_note: FQ3 beat across the board (+37% revenue, raised FY26 guide to $6.42B, record $7.7B backlog); decline is AI-networking rotation, not the business.

watchlist.name: Fidelity National Information Services
watchlist.news_note: Q2 EPS beat but Capital Markets growth outlook cut to 3-3.5% on execution issues; full-year guidance came in below consensus.

watchlist.name: Charter Communications
watchlist.news_note: Accelerating broadband subscriber losses (172k in Q2, vs 140k expected) forced a cut to FY2026 EBITDA guidance (~-1%); fixed-wireless/fiber competition, declining FCF, and the $34.5B Cox merger add execution risk; partly offset by 406k mobile net adds and an EPS beat.

watchlist.name: Albemarle Corporation
watchlist.news_note: Q2 decisive beat (sales +31% to $1.74B, raised Specialties guidance, cut capex); decline is lithium-commodity sentiment.

watchlist.name: Las Vegas Sands
watchlist.news_note: Q2 EPS miss (-23%) on unusually low Macau hold (-$87M); volumes grew across all Macau segments; Marina Bay Sands mass +5%.

watchlist.name: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings
watchlist.news_note: Cut FY26 EPS outlook on weak bookings (Q3 net yield guided -8.9%); still profitable with revenue growing ~5%.

watchlist.name: Western Digital
watchlist.news_note: Strong results with continued analyst Overweight ratings; decline is rotation/valuation reset plus a minor convert-note overhang.

watchlist.name: Corning Inc.
watchlist.news_note: Strong Q2 (Optical +32%) overshadowed by soft Q3 guide and a fresh $2B at-the-market equity offering = dilution overhang.

watchlist.name: Vertiv
watchlist.news_note: 'Good isn't good enough': raised full-year guidance twice; decline is elevated expectations + AI-infrastructure rotation.

watchlist.name: KLA Corporation
watchlist.news_note: Beat revenue/EPS in Q1 and Q2, guided above consensus, raised dividend, 10-for-1 split; stock fell anyway = profit-taking/rotation.

watchlist.name: Erie Indemnity
watchlist.news_note: Q2 (Jul 30) beat EPS ($3.45 vs $3.35 est.), dividend raised 7.1% and Zacks upgraded to Buy mid-Sept, but CEO Timothy NeCastro retiring Dec 31 2026, new business policies fell ~23-24%, sole customer Erie Insurance Exchange downgraded A+ to A by AM Best, and a long-running class action over the management fee is still pending.

watchlist.name: Casey's
watchlist.news_note: Beat earnings twice, raised dividend 14%, Moderate Buy consensus; decline looks like valuation rotation after a strong run.

watchlist.name: CRH plc
watchlist.news_note: Q2 beat with reaffirmed guidance, raised dividend, heavy buybacks; decline looks like sector sentiment, not fundamentals.

watchlist.name: Wynn Resorts
watchlist.news_note: Soft post-World Cup Macau GGR and Iran-war risk to its $5.7B UAE project weigh on shares; core properties remain profitable.

watchlist.name: L3Harris
watchlist.news_note: CEO ousted Aug 17 after a code-of-conduct investigation, triggering a securities probe, though Q2 results and backlog were strong.

watchlist.name: Coherent Corp.
watchlist.news_note: Record FY2026 results (rev +22.5% to $7.12B, non-GAAP EPS +59%), above-consensus Q1 FY27 guide, backlog into 2028; 27% pullback = profit-taking after a pre-earnings rally, not fundamental news.

watchlist.name: Royal Caribbean Group
watchlist.news_note: Q2 beat but annual profit forecast cut on fuel costs; Mexico rejected its water park; $6B+ Sandals acquisition reportedly near.

watchlist.name: AutoZone
watchlist.news_note: Q4 FY26 (Sep 22) beat EPS ($56.05 vs $53.84 est.) on strong FCF ($684M) and $697.5M buybacks; only a slight revenue miss and conservative FY27 guidance (flat to low-single-digit domestic comps) prompted analyst target cuts but ratings held at Buy/Outperform.

watchlist.name: Carnival Corporation
watchlist.news_note: Record Q2 yields, but full-year yield guidance cut and soft Q3 outlook on Iran-war Mediterranean demand and a 30% fuel-cost surge.

watchlist.name: Applied Materials
watchlist.news_note: Record Q3 beat with above-consensus Q4 guide; the fall is sell-the-news after the stock doubled, with China export overhang unchanged.

watchlist.name: Lowe's
watchlist.news_note: Q2 EPS beat but revenue missed and FY2026 guidance cut to the low end amid weak DIY demand, high rates, tariffs.

watchlist.name: Cooper Companies (The)
watchlist.news_note: Q3 revenue missed on flat CooperVision sales with below-consensus Q4/FY2026 EPS guidance, triggering analyst downgrades.

watchlist.name: Martin Marietta Materials
watchlist.news_note: Q2 raised 2026 revenue guidance to $7.2-7.4B with $2.57B buyback completed; no miss, cut, or legal issue found.

watchlist.name: Lam Research
watchlist.news_note: Fell ~30% from late-June highs on AI-capex valuation derating despite record Q4 and raised September guidance.

watchlist.name: Xylem Inc.
watchlist.news_note: Cautious 2026 outlook reset the growth narrative (organic growth decelerating to 2-3% on weaker water-treatment demand, revenue guidance trimmed to ~$9.2B); partially offset by raised EPS guidance ($5.55-$5.70) and margin expansion, but demand softness is a negative fundamental signal.

watchlist.name: IBM
watchlist.news_note: Q2 revenue and EPS missed, infrastructure down 7% (Z-series down 42%), growth outlook tempered to 4-5%.

watchlist.name: Stryker Corporation
watchlist.news_note: Q1 cyber disruption but Q2 rebounded with 9.4% sales growth, EPS beat, narrowed guidance; decline looks like valuation rotation.

watchlist.name: Home Depot (The)
watchlist.news_note: Q2 beat with FY2026 guidance reaffirmed; weakness is housing-market/macro sentiment, not fundamentals.

watchlist.name: Hormel Foods
watchlist.news_note: Q3 revenue missed and FY2026 sales guidance cut as retail volume fell 9% on consumer pullback.

watchlist.name: McDonald's
watchlist.news_note: Q2 missed with U.S. comps of 0.8% on falling traffic; U.S. chief replaced, margin guidance trimmed, 50,000-unit target pushed to 2028.

watchlist.name: Generac
watchlist.news_note: Strong Q2 beat ($2.91 vs $2.01 est), raised margin guidance, $1.6B data-center backlog; residential softness only minor drag.

watchlist.name: Vici Properties
watchlist.news_note: Q2 (Jul 29): revenue beat ($1.06B, +1.9%), EPS missed on cost items; AFFO/share +4.6% YoY to $0.62, FY2026 AFFO guidance raised to $2.45-2.47, dividend raised to $0.46 (7.8% yield); $1.16B Golden Entertainment sale-leaseback, $2.5B liquidity. No guidance cut, distress, or management change.

watchlist.name: Chipotle Mexican Grill
watchlist.news_note: Q2 (Jul 29) beat and FY26 comp guidance was RAISED to low-single-digits, but an Aug 4 multistate Salmonella Javiana outbreak traced to supplier jalapeños (27 illness clusters at Chipotle/Qdoba locations) sparked a ~10% single-day drop, a federal lawsuit and an investor-law-firm probe; product was pulled and FDA says no ongoing risk.

watchlist.name: Old Dominion
watchlist.news_note: Q2 beat (revenue +10.4%, EPS +32.3%, operating ratio improved); decline reflects lofty valuation and soft cyclical freight.

watchlist.name: C.H. Robinson
watchlist.news_note: $604M advisory 'nuclear verdict' in a July Texas trucking case knocked the stock ~9% in a day; Q2 beat with raised targets.

watchlist.name: Flex Ltd.
watchlist.news_note: Beat-and-raise fiscal Q1 2027 (revenue +20.6%, EPS +38.9%) with raised FY27 guide; selloff is post-run profit-taking.

watchlist.name: DaVita
watchlist.news_note: Q2 2026 beat on revenue and EPS with full-year 2026 guidance reaffirmed (EPS $14.10-$15.20) on improving treatment volumes — decline is sentiment/positioning, not fundamentals.

watchlist.name: Tyson Foods
watchlist.news_note: Cut fiscal outlook twice as historic cattle shortage crushes beef margins; closing plants, cutting jobs, but the pressure is cyclical.

watchlist.name: Align Technology
watchlist.news_note: Solid beats but growth narrative reset: full-year 2026 revenue guidance of only 3-4% and below-consensus Q3 revenue guidance as elective dental demand stays soft; no fraud or distress, just demand deceleration.

near_miss.name: Trade Desk (The)
near_miss.news_note: Q2 growth collapsed (+3% YoY, slowest ever); Q3 guide implies ~12% decline; share loss to walled gardens; ~15% headcount cut announced.

near_miss.name: Fair Isaac
near_miss.news_note: Sept 4 FHFA directive ends FICO's mortgage-scoring monopoly (VantageScore 4.0 approved for Fannie/Freddie); structural pricing threat + Senate probe.

near_miss.name: Lululemon Athletica
near_miss.news_note: Three guidance cuts in 2026; Q2 revenue -4%, comps -9% (steepest in company history); share loss to Alo Yoga; fraud class-action probe.

near_miss.name: Pentair
near_miss.news_note: Pool-business inventory collapse; slashed FY guidance (sales -4% to -7%); CFO departed July 14; securities class action filed Sept 15.
